prerequisites.rationale_text: Opportunity cost is the economic quantification of trade-offs. Understanding that resources are scarce and forces constantly conflict (trade-offs) precedes the ability to quantify what specific value is lost when choosing one path over another (opportunity cost).
prerequisites.source_quote: The fundamental essence of this model is the value of the best alternative opportunity you didn't choose. Since it is impossible to pursue every desire, picking one path necessarily means forgoing others.

curation_notes.summary: Structural dependency. Trade-offs establishes the principle (scarce resources, competing demands); opportunity cost provides the measurement (quantifying the value of the best foregone alternative). The Trade-Offs article establishes the conceptual foundation that OC operationalizes.
